title: Regional Sales Manager - South
jobDescription:
Job Title: Regional Sales Head, South – Heavy Electric Vehicle Division Location: Bases in Bangalore, Karnataka (with extensive travel across India) Experience required: 7
- 10 Years Role Overview We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Sales Head to spearhead our Heavy Electric Vehicle (EV) division's sales initiating from South India. This role is pivotal in driving the adoption of SUN Mobility's battery swapping solutions among fleet operators, ensuring seamless collaboration with OEMs and dealership networks. Key Responsibilities Strategic Sales Leadership: Develop and execute sales strategies to promote SUN Mobility's battery swapping solutions for heavy EVs (Bus and Trucks) OEM Collaboration: Work closely with top truck and bus OEMs ensuring alignment with dealership sales processes. Fleet Operator Engagement: Leverage existing relationships and build new connections with fleet owners to drive adoption of SUN Mobility-powered vehicles. Team Building & Management: Recruit, train, and lead a high-performing sales team, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability. Market Analysis: Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to inform product development and marketing strategies. Financial Acumen: Collaborate with financial institutions to facilitate vehicle financing options for fleet operators, understanding the nuances of commercial vehicle financing in India. Language Proficiency: Effectively communicate with stakeholders across in English and Hindi with proficiency in Kannada and Tamil (Operations launching from Karnataka and Tamil Nadu) Qualifications, Experience and Skills

EDUCATION:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA is preferred. Experience: 7–10 years of sales experience in the commercial vehicle sector, specifically with trucks and buses, working with top Indian OEMs. Regional Expertise: Proven track record in sales in Southern India including but not limited to Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh. Must an understanding of regional market dynamics and customer behavior Customer Network & Leads: Established relationships with fleet operators and dealership networks in the Southern Indian market. Proven Experience with Vehicle Financing : Must have past experience with arranging financing for customers with inroads to Banks, NBFCs and Asset financing companies Skills: Strong leadership, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Ability to analyze data and market trends to make informed decision Linguistic Skills : Good proficiency in languages spoken in the region

title: Head – Investor Relations
jobDescription: Role Summary The Head of Investor Relations will be Sun Mobility's primary architect and steward of the investor narrative — building and running the IR function from the ground up, managing relationships with existing and prospective investors, and preparing the organization for future fundraising and potential public listing. This is a high-visibility role reporting to the CSO, working in close partnership with the Chairman, Board, and Corporate Finance/Strategy teams. The ideal candidate has personally been part of a company's IPO journey — from readiness through listing and post-listing investor engagement — and brings a strong external network of institutional investors, analysts, and bankers built up over 12–15 years in relevant capital markets roles. Experience & Qualifications 12–15 years of progressive experience in Investor Relations, Corporate Finance, Equity Research, Investment Banking, or Corporate Development. Demonstrated, hands-on experience having been part of an IPO process (buy-side, sell-side, or in-house) — ideally in India, though international listing experience (US/UK/SPAC) is also relevant. Prior exposure to EV, automotive, auto-ancillary, battery/energy storage, clean energy, or industrial infrastructure sectors is preferable. Track record of engaging with institutional investors, sell-side analysts, and rating agencies, ideally in both private and listed-company contexts. MBA (Finance) / CA / CFA or equivalent professional qualification preferred. Skills & Attributes Deep understanding of capital markets, financial modeling, valuation frameworks, and SEBI/stock exchange regulatory requirements. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate complex operational and financial data into a compelling investor narrative. Strong executive presence — comfortable representing the company directly to CXOs, institutional investors, and board members. High ownership mindset with the ability to build a function from scratch in a fast-scaling, pre-IPO environment. Discretion and judgment in handling sensitive, market-moving information. Key Responsibilities Investor Relations Strategy & Execution Design and lead Sun Mobility's overall investor relations strategy across existing shareholders (PE/VC/strategic investors) and future public market participants. Build the investor communication calendar, including quarterly business updates, board reporting cadence, and formal investor briefings. Develop and continuously refine the equity story, investment thesis, and positioning narrative in partnership with the Senior Leadership. IPO & Capital Markets Readiness Lead IPO-readiness workstreams: financial disclosure processes, corporate governance upgrades, DRHP/RHP input, and coordination with merchant bankers, legal counsel, and auditors. Draw on prior hands-on IPO experience to advise the leadership team on listing structure, timeline, roadshow strategy, and regulatory (SEBI/stock exchange) requirements. Manage the analyst and institutional investor engagement plan through the pre-IPO, roadshow, listing, and post-listing stabilization phases. Own coordination with investment banks, legal advisors, registrars, and regulatory bodies through the listing process. Financial Communications & Reporting Own preparation of investor decks, earnings materials, annual reports, and Management Discussion & Analysis (MD&A) content. Partner with Finance/Accounting to ensure consistency between statutory disclosures, board materials, and external investor communications. Track and benchmark KPIs against comparable EV, battery-swapping, clean energy, and auto-ancillary companies (listed and private) to sharpen positioning. Stakeholder & Relationship Management Serve as a trusted point of contact for existing institutional and strategic investors, fielding queries and coordinating information flow. Build and maintain relationships with sell-side analysts, credit rating agencies, proxy advisors, and the broader investment community. Support fundraising rounds (private and, eventually, public) with data rooms, management presentations, and due-diligence coordination. Governance, Compliance & Risk Ensure all investor-facing communication complies with applicable securities regulations, insider trading codes, and disclosure norms (SEBI LODR, once listed). Maintain a material non-public information (MNPI) protocol and manage blackout periods, board disclosures, and related-party matters. Act as company secretary-adjacent liaison for board and investor governance matters, working closely with the Company Secretary and Legal team.

title: Head – Vehicle Integration (Heavy Electric Vehicle Engineering)
jobDescription: Head – Vehicle Integration (Heavy Electric Vehicle Engineering) Experience: 15–20 Years Location: Bangalore Industry: Automotive / EV / Heavy Electric Vehicle Engineering Role Overview The Head – Vehicle Integration (Electric Bus and trucks) will lead complete vehicle-level integration across powertrain, electrical, thermal, and control systems for heavy electric vehicle platforms. The role ensures seamless system performance, resolves complex engineering issues, drives cross-functional collaboration, and delivers reliable, high-quality EV products aligned with customer and program requirements. About the Role We are seeking an experienced Head – Vehicle Integration (Electric Bus and trucks) to lead complete vehicle-level integration across mechanical, electrical, thermal, and control domains. The ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise, strong customer-facing skills, and demonstrated experience in driving cross-functional engineering teams for heavy EV programs. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end Heavy Electric Vehicle (Bus/Trucks) integration, Traction battery, covering powertrain, thermal management, electrical, and control systems. Perform vehicle performance calculations, motor/engine characteristics analysis, and complete system-level evaluations. Review, validate, and integrate major automotive subsystems with a strong focus on drive quality, safety, and reliability. Oversee VMS (Vehicle Management System) and BMS integration, diagnostics, and issue resolution. Develop and execute test plans to ensure system-level and vehicle-level conformance. Interpret and analyze CAN data, wiring harness diagrams, electrical schematics, and PCB layouts. Collaborate with hardware, software, mechanical, electrical, and controls teams to close technical gaps and optimize vehicle functionality. Engage directly with customers to understand requirements and translate them into engineering deliverables. Lead conflict resolution and manage engineering trade-offs across cross-functional teams. Drive program reviews, milestone tracking, and alignment with corporate processes and engineering standards. Required Skills:- Strong expertise in HVAC, thermal systems, powertrain, battery systems, and overall drive performance. LCV, ICV, MDV and HCV bus and trucks Product knowledge of Indian and Global portfolios Hands-on experience in MCU & VCU software integration , control strategy development, CAN communication, diagnostics, and functional validation. Vehicle and Battery related CMVR knowledge X First hand experience in vehicle CMVR certification processes Extensive experience in vehicle design, system integration, diagnostics, and validation. Excellent understanding of electrical systems, wiring schematics, embedded electronics, and harness architecture. Hands-on experience with CAN analysis tools and vehicle diagnostic interfaces. Excellent communication, documentation, problem-solving, and customer relationship management skills. Proficiency in 3D CAD tools, MS Office, MS Project, and Power Point. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience with automotive OEMs or Tier-1 suppliers. Experience working on bus and truck platforms, EV programs, or high-complexity vehicle builds. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, self-directed, and dynamic engineering environment.

title: Senior Engineer - Wiring Harness
jobDescription:
Job Title: Wiring Harness Sr Engineer Job Description The Wiring Harness Engineer is responsible for the design, development, validation, and production support of wiring harness systems for automotive and electric vehicle applications, ensuring compliance with functional, safety, quality, cost, and manufacturability requirements. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Wiring Harness Design & Development: • Design complete wiring harness architecture including schematics, routing, bundling, and installation. • Develop wiring harnesses for vehicle systems such as Battery, Charging Stations, Battery Dock, and vehicle interface modules. • Select appropriate wires, connectors, terminals, fuses, relays, clips, and protection components based on electrical and environmental requirements. • Ensure compliance with electrical load, voltage drop, derating, and thermal requirements. CAD & Documentation: • Create and maintain wiring schematics, harness assembly drawings, installation drawings, and BOMs. • Use CAD and PLM tools such as Creo Cabling, Creo Schematic, Auto CAD, and Windchill. • Prepare and maintain engineering documents including SOR, SOP, DFMEA inputs, installation guidelines, and ECNs. Cross-Functional Coordination: • Work closely with system engineering, mechanical design, manufacturing, quality, and sourcing teams. • Support supplier interactions, drawing clarifications, and technical reviews. • Participate in design reviews, DFMEA, and change management activities. Validation & Production Support: • Support prototype, pilots, and production builds. • Analyze and resolve wiring-related issues during testing, production, and field use. • Support root cause analysis and corrective actions for harness, connector, and terminal failures. Standards & Compliance: • Ensure designs comply with automotive standards, safety norms, and internal engineering guidelines. • Follow best practices for routing, clipping, protection, and serviceability. Experience & Skills: • 3–8 years of experience in automotive or EV wiring harness design. Technical Skills: • Strong knowledge of electrical schematics and vehicle electrical architecture. • Hands-on experience with wiring harness CAD tools. • Understanding of automotive connectors, terminals, crimping standards, and manufacturing processes. • Knowledge of high-current and low-voltage electrical systems. Soft Skills: • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. • Good communication and documentation skills. • Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams. • High attention to detail and ownership.

EDUCATION:
• BE / BTech in Electrical, Electronics, E&E.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Experience in EV, Battery, charging station. • Exposure to product industrialization and field failure analysis.
